an10.84:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.84:1.3: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.84:2.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti.
an10.84:2.3: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati.
an10.84:2.4: So Tathāgatena vā Tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno iriṇaṃ āpajjati, vijinaṃ āpajjati, anayaṃ āpajjati, vyasanaṃ āpajjati, anayavyasanaṃ āpajjati.
an10.84:3.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti:
an10.84:3.2: Kin nu kho ayam āyasmā aññaṃ vyākaroti
an10.84:3.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti?
an10.84:4.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an10.84:5.3: kodhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:6.3: upanāhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:7.3: makkhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:8.3: paḷāsapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:9.3: issāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:10.3: maccherapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:11.3: sāṭheyyapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:12.3: māyāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:13.3: icchāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.84:14.1: Muṭṭhassati kho panāyam āyasmā uttarikaraṇīye oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpanno,
an10.84:14.2: antarāvosānagamanaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ. 3.
an10.84:15.1: So vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme appahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī ti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an10.84:15.2: So vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme pahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatī
